issues.explanation: sendInvite deletes rows where accepted_at is not null, destroying accepted-invite history when only expired invites may be replaced.
Public input properties use inline validate() rules only with no #[Validate] attributes as required by the project pattern.
selectedMembershipId is server context used to load and mutate memberships but is not #[Locked], leaving it client-writable.
confirmRemoval and cancelRemoval perform no server-side authorization check.
Invite creation, membership creation, role updates and deletes write via Eloquent directly instead of app/Actions/* one-class-per-use-case.
Catching every QueryException converts unrelated database failures into an inviteEmail validation error, hiding real errors.

conventions.evidence: Members.php:44-56 no #[Validate]; Members.php:52 no #[Locked]; direct EntityInvite::create / membership update/delete instead of app/Actions/*; docs and audit logging follow conventions

readability.evidence: Members.php:66-141 sendInvite is long but named clearly; Blade modals use semantic Bulma markup with explicit titles; isInvitee helper is clear

requirements.evidence: Members.php:66-141 sendInvite validates, rejects members/pending, handles race, rate-limits, queues mail; PendingInvites.php:274-322 accept/decline with 403/expired/idempotent/firstOrCreate; but Members.php:108-110 deletes accepted invites

scope.evidence: All hunks map to task: entity_invites table, mail, Livewire components, switcher/onboarding slots, members UI, routes, lang, docs, tests; no unrelated features

security.evidence: Members.php:60 authorize update and scoped lookups with abort 404; PendingInvites.php:278 abort_unless isInvitee; but Members.php:52 unlocked ID and Members.php:218-226 unauthorised toggles

simplicity.evidence: Reuses Eloquent relations, RateLimiter, Mail::queue, existing policies; no new services or abstractions; single delete-then-create for expired replacement

tests.evidence: tests/Feature/Entity/EntityInvitesTest.php and MembersTest.php cover normalization, factory, send/cancel, validation, duplicates, race, rate-limit, accept/decline, 403, tamper, mail content, UI titles and hr rules

review.summary: Invite-only membership, manager-only members page with detail and removal modals, and queued invite mail are implemented with strong Pest coverage. Needs changes before merging because accepted invites are deleted on replacement, Livewire inputs lack #[Validate]/#[Locked], domain writes bypass app/Actions, and two UI-toggle actions lack authorization.
